michelle_prod: Quick internal notice 026-03: weve opened an early Dedicated pool of A100X GPUs in eu-west-2 (a/c). Limited capacity for migration pilots and urgent enterprise needs.

devin_infra: Pool facts: 8 A100X GPUs per zone (total 16). Soft per-account cap = 4 GPUs/zone. To request increases, submit a quota request under 'Dedicated GPU - A100X' and include expected token/sec and peak sequence length. Typical review ~48-72h.

elaine_pm: Is there any promotional pricing for customers switching from hosted to Dedicated?

michelle_prod: No general promo for the initial rollout. Sales can request one-off migration credits via AM intake. Priority allocation: 1) current Dedicated customers upgrading, 2) enterprise customers with active SLOs, 3) selected pilots.

infra-bot: Telemetry snapshot (eu-west-2a/c): p95 latency 60ms, p99 95ms, avg gpu util 54%, no failed instances.

sam_support: Support reminder: include quota request ID in tickets so we can route faster. Tag #dedicated-ops for urgent escalations.

devin_infra: Ops items: adding a soft-threshold alert (email) at 30% spare capacity, and a pager at 10% spare. Also adding reservation field reserve_mode: "soft"|"hard" to the API.

michelle_prod: Action list: (1) eng-infra add alerts @devin_infra, (2) support publish KB article for migration checklist @sam_support, (3) PMs coordinate partner pilots @elaine_pm.

elaine_pm: I'll kick off partner outreach and capture feedback forms.

michelle_prod: We'll wait 48h for pool stability metrics before any external announcement. Thanks team :thumbsup:
